address.docs:
**int**: The I²C address of the sensor. See [I²C Addresses](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/tmp117#tmp117_i2c_addresses) for more information.

*See also: [TMP117 Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/tmp117#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to check the sensor. Defaults to `60s`. The sensor component sets the maximum possible averaging in the sensor based on this.

*See also: [TMP117 Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/tmp117#configuration-variables)*
